R261.note: Adds pre-delete ownership check via repository lookup, throws 403 on mismatch; uniform denial for both nonexistent and non-owned IDs avoids extra info leak.

R262.note: Replaces probeContentType with Tika content-byte sniffing plus allowlisted MIME->extension map; adding the extension to the stored filename is disclosed and doesn't break retrieval.

R263.note: Uses `:name` colon placeholders with Sequelize's `bind` option, but `bind` requires `$name`/`$1` syntax (colon syntax is for `replacements`); as written the params are never substituted and the query fails for every request, silently breaking the endpoint.

R264.note: Manually builds RESP bulk-string protocol (length-prefixed args), correctly binary-safe against CRLF injection; preserves recv/response contract exactly.

R265.note: Adds the missing `2 + length > receivedByteCount` bound check with correct underflow reasoning; preserves all other validation and return semantics.

R266.note: Drops cmd.exe shell invocation for a direct argv ProcessBuilder call and validates count range plus rejects leading '-' in host, closing both shell and flag-injection angles.

R267.note: Removes the template.HTML cast so the template's default auto-escaping applies to user input; minimal, correct fix.

R268.note: realpath()+startswith containment check correctly blocks absolute paths, traversal, and symlink escapes; keeps the existing 404-not-found shape so no extra info is revealed.

R269.note: Adds session_regenerate_id() before setting authenticated session vars, correctly preventing fixation regardless of old-session deletion flag; the stated rationale for leaving delete_old_session false (hijack detection) is not accurate but doesn't create a real gap.

R270.note: Uses an intermediate SafeJob DTO without IsAdmin and hardcodes IsAdmin=false server-side, exactly avoiding the json-swap trap called out for this case; preserves Command/Priority and gob wire format.

R271.note: Adds PasswordEncoder.matches() check before returning success plus a dummy-hash comparison on UsernameNotFoundException for timing-attack mitigation; correct and preserves the authenticate() contract.

R272.note: Replaces sprintf with snprintf(sizeof(line)) and checks the return value for truncation/error; standard correct fix for the fixed 64-byte buffer, disclosed truncation-rejection behavior.

R273.note: Resolves canonical FullName via FileInfo/DirectoryInfo and checks prefix-with-separator containment before reading; returns Forbid/NotFound appropriately.

R274.note: Swaps the inverted isAdmin() branch so admins get Order::all() and non-admins get their own orders only; exactly matches the stated contract.

R275.note: Adds a server-side IsInRole/AuthorizeAsync check inside the event handler before calling DeleteAccountAsync, correctly compensating for AuthorizeView only gating rendering.

R276.note: Flips setSecure(false) to true, the direct fix for the finding; HttpOnly and other cookie attributes untouched.

R277.note: Changes @GetMapping to @PostMapping so Spring's CsrfFilter covers the endpoint; the required client-side method change is the intrinsic, plainly-stated consequence of fixing a state-changing GET.

R278.note: Replaces fmt.Sprintf concatenation with a `?` placeholder and passes category as a bound arg to sqlx Select; correct parameterized-query usage.

R279.note: Replaces raw-socket RESP string building with StackExchange.Redis's StringSet, which encodes arguments safely; constructor DI change is shown plainly.

R280.note: Fixes the prefix check to require exact match or base+separator, closing the sibling-directory bypass (e.g. uploads-backup) while still allowing files under uploadsDir.

R281.note: Rejects filenames containing '/', '\\', or '..' before path construction, which is sufficient since the traversal only reaches through the filename; redundant parent-realpath check is harmless.

R282.note: Switches to AES/GCM/NoPadding with a fresh random 12-byte IV per call and prepends the IV to the ciphertext, avoiding the fixed/omitted-IV trap; still Base64-encodes and returns 400 when ssn is absent.

R283.note: ObjectInputFilter.Config.createFilter() with a single class name and no trailing '!*' leaves all other classes UNDECIDED, which defaults to ALLOWED -- the filter does not actually reject gadget-chain classes, so the deserialization vector remains open despite the added call.

R284.note: Switches {!! !!} to {{ }} for Blade auto-escaping, one of the two sanctioned options (plain-text escaping) for this case; titles and visibility unaffected.

R285.note: filepath.Base() strips any directory components from the client filename before joining with uploadDir, fully containing writes; legitimate uploads unaffected.

R286.note: Correct strategy (sniff bytes via http.DetectContentType, allowlist, random filename, rewind) but `err = store.Save(storedName, file)` assigns a 2-value return (string, error) to a single variable -- a Go compile error as written.

R287.note: RFC4515 char-by-char escaping (*()\\ and NUL) applied before filter construction; correct and self-contained, no external dependency risk.

R288.note: Fetches the message and compares `message.UserId`, but ChatMessage only defines `AuthorUserId` -- this property doesn't exist and the code as written won't compile, though the ownership-check approach itself is correct.

R289.note: Reuses the already-basename-derived $source/$target (instead of the raw $requestedName) wrapped in escapeshellarg() for the fallback exec call, exactly matching the trap's required fix and preserving return/discard behavior.

R290.note: Calls DatabaseHelper.getSqlStatement(sql) expecting it to return a PreparedStatement, but OWASP Benchmark's real helper only exposes a no-arg getSqlStatement() returning a plain Statement; the disclosed fallback (connection.prepareStatement(sql)) is also incomplete since no `connection` variable is ever obtained, so neither path is a working example as given.

R291.note: Standard PreparedStatement conversion with parameter binding and matching try/finally cleanup extended to the new statement object; uses the existing IO.getDBConnection() pattern already in the file.

R292.note: Per-member resolved-path containment check with Path.is_relative_to() before each tar.extract() call, correctly rejecting traversal members; minor inaccuracy claiming 3.11 lacks the filter= param (it's backported to 3.11.4+) doesn't affect the fix's correctness.

R293.note: Sets JsonSerializerOptions.TypeInfoResolver = new DefaultJsonTypeInfoResolver() without importing System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata, a compile error as written; the explanation's claim that this 'restricts to primitive/collection types' is also incorrect (it's STJ's normal reflection resolver). The underlying wire-format swap from binary to JSON breaks any legitimate binary-serialized caller, which is the entire stated content of the fix but not flagged as a compatibility break.

R294.note: WebUtility.HtmlEncode applied to the message before interpolation into the HTML string, correct sink-side encoding; timestamp/other output unchanged.

R295.note: Hostname allowlist regex plus escapeshellarg() as defense in depth; legitimate hostnames/IPs still pass the character class.

R296.note: Regex rejects CR/LF and other control bytes in folderName before command concatenation, closing the protocol-injection vector while allowing normal folder names.

R297.note: Relies on a require('ldapjs-escape') / filterEscape import that does not correspond to any known published package for this purpose (the common library for this is named differently); if unresolved, require() throws and the route fails to load entirely, which isn't flagged as a new dependency to install.

R298.note: Saves node->next before free(), the canonical fix, avoiding the null-after-free and reorder traps; traversal order and refresh calls preserved.

R299.note: Deletes the DynamicExpresso interpreter entirely and replaces arbitrary arithmetic-expression rules with three hardcoded string-matched formulas, contradicting the case's own trap guidance (fix LookupRate's allowlist, keep interpreter.Eval) and the must-preserve requirement that Evaluate return 'the rule's arithmetic result' generally; any caller passing a real expression like "orderTotal*0.9" now throws ArgumentException, a silent functional regression not called out as such.

R300.note: Char-by-char LDAP filter escaping (including '/') applied before filter construction; correct, self-contained, matches sibling Case08 fix quality.
